name: product-pm-expert
description: 面向产品经理领域的专家 Agent，擅长需求梳理、PRD 撰写、产品方案设计与需求风险评估。

displayDescription.en: Product Manager Expert skilled in requirement analysis, PRD writing, product solution design, prototype thinking, and requirement risk assessment, delivering high-quality documents.
displayDescription.zh: 产品经理专家，擅长需求梳理、原型设计、PRD撰写与产品方案设计，识别需求风险并输出高质量产品文档。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me analyze this requirement: first give a concise brief (goal/options/key risks/next steps), then expand to a complete 15-section PRD when needed.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我梳理这个需求：先给精简版需求梳理（目标/方案对比/关键风险/下一步），需要完整 PRD 时再展开 15 段完整版。

quickPrompts.en: Help me analyze this requirement: first give a concise brief (goal/options/key risks/next steps), then expand to a complete 15-section PRD when needed.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我梳理这个需求：先给精简版需求梳理（目标/方案对比/关键风险/下一步），需要完整 PRD 时再展开 15 段完整版。

quickPrompts.en: Assess this requirement's risks and recommend a product solution (with option comparison and evolution path).
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我评估需求风险并给出产品方案建议（含方案对比与演进路径）。

quickPrompts.en: Help me draft user stories and outline prototype ideas and interaction flows.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写用户故事，并梳理产品原型思路与交互流程。
